sub_graphs.title: Cancun: Transaction Processing Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the complete lifecycle of transactions from receipt through validation and hashing

nodes.label: Transaction Bytes Received
nodes.description: Raw transaction bytes received from external source

nodes.label: Decode Transaction
nodes.description: Decode transaction bytes to determine type and parse fields

nodes.label: Transaction Decoded
nodes.description: Transaction successfully decoded into typed structure (Legacy, AccessList, FeeMarket, or Blob)

nodes.label: Recover Sender Address
nodes.description: Recover sender address from transaction signature using SECP256K1

nodes.label: Sender Address Recovered
nodes.description: Sender address extracted from signature, ready for validation

nodes.label: Validate Transaction
nodes.description: Validate gas sufficiency, nonce bounds, and init code size

nodes.label: Transaction Valid
nodes.description: Transaction passes all validation checks

nodes.label: Compute Transaction Hash
nodes.description: Compute Keccak256 hash of encoded transaction for identification

nodes.label: Transaction Ready for Execution
nodes.description: Transaction fully validated with hash computed

edges.label: Transaction submitted via RPC or P2P

external_entities.name: Transaction Source
external_entities.description: External source of transactions (user via RPC, peer via P2P)

sub_graphs.title: Cancun: Transaction Type Discrimination
sub_graphs.description: Models how different transaction types are identified and processed

nodes.label: Typed Transaction Received
nodes.description: Transaction with EIP-2718 type prefix received

nodes.label: Extract Type Byte
nodes.description: Read first byte to determine transaction type

nodes.label: Type 0x01 Identified
nodes.description: EIP-2930 Access List transaction identified

nodes.label: Type 0x02 Identified
nodes.description: EIP-1559 Fee Market transaction identified

nodes.label: Type 0x03 Identified
nodes.description: EIP-4844 Blob transaction identified

nodes.label: Legacy Transaction
nodes.description: Pre-typed legacy transaction (first byte >= 0xC0)

nodes.label: Decode Access List Transaction
nodes.description: Parse EIP-2930 transaction fields including access list

nodes.label: Decode Fee Market Transaction
nodes.description: Parse EIP-1559 transaction with dynamic fee fields

nodes.label: Decode Blob Transaction
nodes.description: Parse EIP-4844 transaction with blob gas and versioned hashes

sub_graphs.title: Cancun: Intrinsic Gas Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the intrinsic gas cost calculation for transactions

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Gas Calculation
nodes.description: Decoded transaction ready for intrinsic gas calculation

nodes.label: Calculate Base Cost
nodes.description: Add TX_BASE_COST (21000 gas)

nodes.label: Calculate Data Cost
nodes.description: Sum gas for data bytes: 4 per zero byte, 16 per non-zero byte

nodes.label: Calculate Creation Cost
nodes.description: Add 32000 gas plus init code cost for contract creation

nodes.label: Calculate Access List Cost
nodes.description: Add 2400 per address, 1900 per storage key in access list

nodes.label: Intrinsic Gas Computed
nodes.description: Total intrinsic gas cost calculated

nodes.label: Compare Against Gas Limit
nodes.description: Verify transaction gas limit >= intrinsic gas

nodes.label: Gas Sufficient
nodes.description: Transaction has enough gas for intrinsic costs

nodes.label: Gas Insufficient Error
nodes.description: InsufficientTransactionGasError - gas limit too low

sub_graphs.title: Cancun: Signature Recovery and Verification
sub_graphs.description: Models the cryptographic signature verification process for sender recovery

nodes.label: Transaction Signature Pending Verification
nodes.description: Transaction with signature components ready for verification

nodes.label: Validate R and S Bounds
nodes.description: Check r and s are within SECP256K1 curve parameters

nodes.label: Signature Bounds Valid
nodes.description: R and S values within valid range

nodes.label: Signature Bounds Invalid
nodes.description: R or S outside valid range - signature rejected

nodes.label: Compute Signing Hash
nodes.description: Compute transaction signing hash based on type (pre-155, 155, 2930, 1559, 4844)

nodes.label: Signing Hash Computed
nodes.description: Keccak256 signing hash ready for recovery

nodes.label: SECP256K1 Public Key Recovery
nodes.description: Recover public key from signature and signing hash

nodes.label: Public Key Recovered
nodes.description: 65-byte uncompressed public key extracted

nodes.label: Derive Address from Public Key
nodes.description: Compute Keccak256 of public key, take last 20 bytes as address

nodes.label: Sender Address Derived
nodes.description: 20-byte sender address computed from signature

external_entities.name: Transaction Signer
external_entities.description: External entity that created the transaction signature

sub_graphs.title: Cancun: Transaction Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation constraints enforced on transactions

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Validation
nodes.description: Decoded transaction with sender ready for rule validation

nodes.label: Check Gas Sufficiency
nodes.description: Verify gas limit exceeds intrinsic cost

nodes.label: Gas Check Passed
nodes.description: Transaction has sufficient gas for intrinsic operations

nodes.label: Check Nonce Overflow
nodes.description: Verify nonce < 2^64 - 1 (EIP-2681)

nodes.label: Nonce Valid
nodes.description: Nonce within acceptable bounds

nodes.label: Nonce Overflow Error
nodes.description: NonceOverflowError - nonce at maximum value

nodes.label: Check Init Code Size
nodes.description: For contract creation, verify data size <= MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE

nodes.label: Init Code Size Valid
nodes.description: Contract creation init code within size limit

nodes.label: Init Code Too Large Error
nodes.description: InitCodeTooLargeError - init code exceeds limit

nodes.label: Transaction Fully Validated
nodes.description: All validation rules passed

edges.label: Check init code if creation tx

ambiguities.text: The specification mentions 'pre-155' and '155' signature schemes but does not clarify how to detect which scheme was used for legacy transactions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume v value determines scheme: v ∈ {27, 28} indicates pre-EIP155, chain-dependent v values indicate EIP-155. Detection based on v value range.

ambiguities.text: MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE is referenced but the exact value is not specified in this module.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE = 49152 bytes (48 KB) per EIP-3860.

ambiguities.text: The encoding of BlobTransaction does not clarify if blob_versioned_hashes can be empty.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume at least one blob is required based on NoBlobDataError exception. Empty hashes array should trigger validation error.

implicit_assumptions.description: Signature recovery assumes the SECP256K1 cryptographic library is correctly implemented and secure.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Flawed ECDSA implementation could allow signature forgery or incorrect sender recovery.

implicit_assumptions.description: The system assumes attackers cannot compute valid signatures without the corresponding private key.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Private key compromise or cryptographic break would allow unauthorized transactions.

implicit_assumptions.description: Chain ID validation assumes all nodes agree on the correct chain ID for replay protection.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Chain ID mismatch could allow cross-chain replay attacks or transaction rejection.

implicit_assumptions.description: Gas cost constants (TX_BASE_COST, etc.) are assumed to be correctly configured for the Cancun fork.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect gas constants could lead to under-priced operations enabling DoS attacks.
